app_info.subtitle: Product price analytics
app_info.description: Pricewatcha provides product price analytics: search the catalog, inspect historical lows/highs/averages and trends, track merchant product URLs, manage watchlists, and create price alerts.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves Pricewatcha API health and discovery metadata without creating or updating records.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish content or change publicly visible internet state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Submits a public product URL and may create or continue a Pricewatcha tracking job.
justifications.open_world_justification: Fetches product data from independently controlled merchant websites and shop APIs.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete alerts, revoke access, or overwrite irreversible user data; tracking is additive.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves the current status and outcome of an existing tracking job.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish content or change publicly visible internet state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves structured product price intelligence for a product ID.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish content or change publicly visible internet state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves historical price data, aggregates, and trend information for a product ID.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish content or change publicly visible internet state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only searches the public Pricewatcha product catalog and returns matching product-level records.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish content or change publicly visible internet state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates a new price alert for the authenticated Pricewatcha account.
justifications.open_world_justification: May send notifications through user-controlled channels such as email or webhooks.
justifications.destructive_justification: Creates a new alert; it does not delete existing alerts or revoke access.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only lists existing price alerts for the authenticated account.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish content or change publicly visible internet state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves one existing price alert for the authenticated account.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish content or change publicly visible internet state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Updates thresholds, directional flags, or status of an existing alert.
justifications.open_world_justification: Can change notification routing such as webhook or email settings.
justifications.destructive_justification: Can disable an alert or overwrite thresholds in a hard-to-reverse way without creating a new alert.

justifications.read_only_justification: Deletes an existing price alert for the authenticated account.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish content or change publicly visible internet state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Permanently removes the alert; recreation requires a new create call.

justifications.read_only_justification: Adds a product to the authenticated account watchlist for ongoing updates.
justifications.open_world_justification: Triggers recurring external merchant checks for the watched product.
justifications.destructive_justification: Adds watch state; it does not delete alerts or revoke access.

justifications.read_only_justification: Removes a product from the authenticated account watchlist.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish content or change publicly visible internet state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Stops continuous updates for that product until watched again.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only lists watched products for the authenticated account.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish content or change publicly visible internet state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only reports whether a product is currently watched.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish content or change publicly visible internet state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

test_cases.description: Check whether the Pricewatcha API is available before using product tools.
test_cases.user_prompt: Can Pricewatcha respond right now, and what API version is available?
test_cases.expected_output: Returns Pricewatcha health and API discovery details with a clear availability summary.

test_cases.description: Submit a public merchant URL for tracking and report the immediate job outcome.
test_cases.user_prompt: Track this product price for me: https://www.backmarket.de/de-de/p/example-product
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the tracking job status and either product details when completed or a job ID to poll when still running.

test_cases.description: Retrieve structured product intelligence for a known demo product ID.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show me the current Pricewatcha data for demo_iphone_15_pro.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the product name, shop, current price, currency, status, and last checked information when available.

test_cases.description: Review price history and trend data for a product ID.
test_cases.user_prompt: Is demo_iphone_15_pro historically cheap right now?
test_cases.expected_output: Returns current price, historical low and high, average price, trend, and enough context to compare today's price to history.

test_cases.description: Search the public catalog by product name.
test_cases.user_prompt: Find iPhone 15 Pro products in the Pricewatcha catalog.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns matching catalog products with product IDs and product-level price fields for follow-up lookups.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for account login or API key creation requests.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Log in to my Pricewatcha account and create a new API key.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because the exposed tools do not authenticate users or manage API keys.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for unrelated shopping advice without a Pricewatcha lookup or track request.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Which laptop should I buy for video editing?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked unless the user asks to search, track, or inspect Pricewatcha product data.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for requests to change merchant websites or public listings.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Update the price shown on this merchant product page to 399 euros.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because it cannot modify merchant sites or public product listings.

release_notes: 1.0.5: Include demo walkthrough URL for MCP review (Cloudflare R2 assets).
